declarations.statement:
theorem finitePart_convex_of_subdifferentiable (f : E → EReal) (V : Set E)
    (hV : Convex ℝ V) (hp : BanditRL.OnlineConvex.SourceProper f)
    (hs : ∀ x ∈ V, (BanditRL.OnlineConvex.SourceSubdifferential f x).Nonempty) :
    ConvexOn ℝ V (fun x => (f x).toReal)

declarations.name: proximal_finitePart_minimizer_iff
declarations.context: variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
declarations.statement:
theorem proximal_finitePart_minimizer_iff (f : E → EReal) (V : Set E)
    (ψ : E → ℝ) (η : ℝ) (x p : E) (hp : p ∈ V)
    (hfin : ∀ z ∈ V, f z ≠ ⊤ ∧ f z ≠ ⊥) :
    IsMinOn (fun z => f z + ((η⁻¹ * divergence ψ z x : ℝ) : EReal)) V p ↔
      IsMinOn (fun z => (f z).toReal + η⁻¹ * divergence ψ z x) V p

declarations.name: proximal_one_step_extended
declarations.context: variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
declarations.statement:
theorem proximal_one_step_extended (f : E → EReal) (V : Set E)
    (hV : Convex ℝ V) (hf : BanditRL.OnlineConvex.SourceProper f)
    (hs : ∀ z ∈ V, (BanditRL.OnlineConvex.SourceSubdifferential f z).Nonempty)
    (ψ : E → ℝ) (η : ℝ) (hη : 0 < η) (x p : E) (hp : p ∈ V)
    (hdx : DifferentiableAt ℝ ψ x) (hdp : DifferentiableAt ℝ ψ p)
    (hmin : IsMinOn (fun z => f z + ((η⁻¹ * divergence ψ z x : ℝ) : EReal)) V p) :
    ∀ u ∈ V, η * ((f p).toReal - (f u).toReal) ≤
      divergence ψ u x - divergence ψ u p - divergence ψ p x

declarations.name: restricted_absolute_nonquadratic
declarations.statement:
theorem restricted_absolute_nonquadratic :
    let V : Set ℝ := Icc (-1) 1
    let f : ℝ → EReal := fun z => if z ∈ V then ((|z| : ℝ) : EReal) else ⊤
    let ψ : ℝ → ℝ := fun z => z ^ 4 / 4 + z ^ 2 / 2
    SourceProper f ∧
      (∀ z ∈ V, (SourceSubdifferential f z).Nonempty) ∧
      f 2 = ⊤ ∧
      ConvexOn ℝ V (fun z => (f z).toReal) ∧
      ¬ ConvexOn ℝ (univ : Set ℝ) (fun z => (f z).toReal) ∧
      StrictConvexOn ℝ univ ψ ∧
      IsMinOn (fun z => f z + ((divergence ψ z (1 / 2) : ℝ) : EReal)) V 0 ∧
      ¬ DifferentiableAt ℝ (abs : ℝ → ℝ) 0 ∧
      divergence ψ (1 / 2) 0 = 9 / 64 ∧
      divergence ψ 0 (1 / 2) = 11 / 64 ∧
      (∀ u ∈ V, -|u| ≤ divergence ψ u (1 / 2) - divergence ψ u 0 - divergence ψ 0 (1 / 2)) ∧
      (-1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ -5 / 16

declarations.name: restricted_linear_outside_center
declarations.statement:
theorem restricted_linear_outside_center :
    let V : Set ℝ := Icc 0 1
    let f : ℝ → EReal := fun z => if z ∈ V then (z : EReal) else ⊤
    let ψ : ℝ → ℝ := fun z => z ^ 2 / 2
    SourceProper f ∧
      (∀ z ∈ V, (SourceSubdifferential f z).Nonempty) ∧
      f (-1) = ⊤ ∧
      (-1 : ℝ) ∉ V ∧
      ConvexOn ℝ V (fun z => (f z).toReal) ∧
      ¬ ConvexOn ℝ (univ : Set ℝ) (fun z => (f z).toReal) ∧
      StrictConvexOn ℝ univ ψ ∧
      IsMinOn (fun z => f z + ((divergence ψ z (-1) : ℝ) : EReal)) V 0 ∧
      divergence ψ 0 (-1) = 1 / 2 ∧
      (∀ u ∈ V, -u ≤ divergence ψ u (-1) - divergence ψ u 0 - divergence ψ 0 (-1)) ∧
      (-1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2
